outdoor activities: Our class enjoys outdoor activities such as hiking, camping, and riding bikes along the river on weekends.
我們班喜歡戶外活動，例如週末去健行、露營和沿著河邊騎腳踏車。
the great outdoors: After a long week in the office, my father loves to escape to the great outdoors and sleep under the stars.
在辦公室忙了一整週後，我爸爸喜歡逃到大自然裡，在星空下睡覺。
outdoor clothing: Before the mountain trip, we bought warm, waterproof outdoor clothing so that the rain and wind would not bother us.
登山之旅前，我們買了保暖防水的戶外服裝，這樣風雨就不會困擾我們。
an outdoor type: Tom is an outdoor type who spends every free weekend fishing, climbing mountains, or surfing at the beach.
湯姆是個喜愛戶外的人，每個空閒的週末都去釣魚、爬山或到海邊衝浪。
outer space: Astronauts must wear special suits in outer space because there is no air to breathe outside the spaceship.
太空人在外太空必須穿特殊的太空衣，因為太空船外沒有空氣可以呼吸。
the outer limits: The marathon pushed the runners to the outer limits of their strength, and some of them fainted at the finish line.
這場馬拉松把跑者推到體力的外圍極限，有些人在終點線昏倒了。
outer clothing: When you enter the temple, please take off your outer clothing, such as coats and jackets, and leave it at the door.
進入寺廟時，請脫下外衣，例如大衣和夾克，並把它們放在門口。
the outer edge: The little boy stood at the outer edge of the circle, too shy to join the other children in the game.
那個小男孩站在圓圈的外緣，害羞得不敢加入其他孩子的遊戲。
the outer islands: Doctors are hard to find on the outer islands, so sick people often have to take a boat to the main island.
離島很難找到醫生，所以生病的人常常得搭船到本島。
outstanding debts: Even though most of the loan has been repaid, the family still has a few outstanding debts to clear this year.
雖然大部分貸款已還清，這家人今年仍有幾筆未償債務要還清。
an outstanding achievement: Winning a gold medal at her first Olympics was an outstanding achievement for the seventeen-year-old swimmer.
在她第一次參加奧運就贏得金牌，對這位十七歲的游泳選手來說是傑出的成就。
outstanding issues: The meeting ended late because there were still several outstanding issues that nobody had found a way to solve.
會議很晚才結束，因為還有幾個未解決的問題沒有人找到解決方法。
outstanding payments: The shop sent a letter asking customers to settle all outstanding payments before the end of the month.
這家店寄信請顧客在月底前結清所有未付款項。
an outstanding student: Amy is an outstanding student who gets top grades in every subject and won the school's academic award this year.
艾咪是一位傑出的學生，每一科都拿最高分，今年還獲得學校的學業獎。
the Oval Office: The president gave an important speech from the Oval Office in the White House last night.
總統昨晚在白宮的橢圓形辦公室發表了一場重要演說。
an oval face: With her oval face and large eyes, the actress looks beautiful in almost any hairstyle.
這位女演員有著鵝蛋臉和大眼睛，幾乎任何髮型都很好看。
an oval table: Because an oval table has no sharp corners, it is safer for families with young children.
因為橢圓桌沒有尖角，對有小孩的家庭來說比較安全。
the overall effect: The colors in the room are simple, but the overall effect is warm and comfortable.
這個房間的顏色很簡單，但整體效果溫暖又舒適。
overall responsibility: As the team leader, Mr. Lin has overall responsibility for the project, so every decision must be approved by him.
身為團隊領導人，林先生對這個計畫負全盤責任，所以每個決定都必須經過他同意。
an overall majority: The party won an overall majority, more than half of all the seats, so it can pass laws without help from others.
該黨贏得絕對多數，超過所有席次的一半，所以不需他黨協助就能通過法律。
overall performance: Although he did badly on one test, his overall performance this semester was good enough to pass the class.
雖然他有一次考試考不好，但他這學期的整體表現足以通過這門課。
the overall picture: Don't worry about one bad month; if you look at the overall picture, our sales have grown a lot this year.
別擔心一個月的不好表現；如果你看整體情況，我們今年的銷售成長了很多。
overhead costs: The company moved to a smaller office to reduce overhead costs like rent, electricity, and water bills.
公司搬到較小的辦公室，以減少租金、電費和水費等間接費用。
an overhead projector: In the past, teachers used an overhead projector to show notes on the wall, but now most classrooms use computers.
過去老師用投影機把筆記投在牆上，但現在大多數教室都用電腦。
overhead wires: During the typhoon, a tree fell onto the overhead wires, and the whole street lost power for hours.
颱風期間，一棵樹倒在架空電線上，整條街停電好幾個小時。
fly overhead: We looked up in surprise when we heard dozens of wild birds fly overhead on their way south.
我們聽到數十隻野鳥在南飛途中從頭頂飛過時，驚訝地抬頭看。
an overnight success: The singer became an overnight success after her video got ten million views in just one day.
這位歌手的影片在一天內獲得一千萬次觀看後，她就一夜成名了。
an overnight stay: The hotel offers a special price for an overnight stay, including dinner and breakfast the next morning.
這間飯店提供過夜的特價方案，包含晚餐和隔天早上的早餐。
overnight delivery: If you order before six p.m., you can choose overnight delivery and get the package tomorrow morning.
如果你在晚上六點前下單，可以選擇隔夜送達，明天早上就能收到包裹。
change overnight: Bad habits don't change overnight, so be patient and keep trying a little every day.
壞習慣不會一夕之間改變，所以要有耐心，每天持續努力一點。
an overnight bag: Since we were only staying one night at Grandma's house, I packed a small overnight bag with pajamas and a toothbrush.
因為我們只在奶奶家住一晚，我打包了一個裝著睡衣和牙刷的過夜小旅行袋。
